rows.name: Sentora Curator
farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the $1,000 you plan to farm Sentora Curator with, fund it on Ethereum, and keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: $9.00 of gas on Ethereum. Time: 10 minutes.

Deposit $1,000 of USDC into a Sentora Curator vault on Ethereum — pick the vault whose mandate and underlying markets you can name, and keep the vault shares. Cost: $18.00 of gas on Ethereum. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Read the curator's allocation page for that vault: which lending markets hold the money, and what the curator earns for steering it. Cost: no gas — it is reading, not transacting. Time: 15 minutes.

Check the vault's redemption queue and withdrawal terms before you add another cent; a queue that is growing is the risk, not the yield. Cost: no gas — it is reading, not transacting. Time: 10 minutes.
Rebalance or top up the position once a week so the deposit is active in more than one allocation snapshot. Cost: $45.00 of gas on Ethereum across the hold. Time: 10 minutes a week for 5 weeks.

Hold the position for at least 30 days, checking Sentora Curator's own points or rewards page weekly, and claim only from a link the protocol itself publishes. Cost: no gas to look, and never pay to claim. Time: 5 minutes a week for 5 weeks.

Add it up before you commit: on $1,000 the expected slice is $3.18, fees −$73.00, T-bill yield forgone −$3.70, net −$73.52 for 2.2 hours of work (−$33.93 an hour) — verdict SKIP. Hold the asset in the farming wallet so the accrual and the holding period are both visible on-chain. Cost: no gas — it is reading, not transacting. Time: 15 minutes.
Read the issuer's redemption terms and the asset's underlying report; off-chain yield is a promise, and its paperwork is the risk. Cost: no gas — it is reading, not transacting. Time: 10 minutes.

Check the accrual and any new issuance window once a week, and top up only inside a window the issuer itself opens. Cost: $45.00 of gas on Ethereum across the hold. Time: 10 minutes a week for 5 weeks.

Hold the position for at least 30 days, checking Plume Vaults's own points or rewards page weekly, and claim only from a link the protocol itself publishes. Cost: no gas to look, and never pay to claim. Time: 5 minutes a week for 5 weeks.

Add it up before you commit: on $1,000 the expected slice is $9.28, fees −$73.00, T-bill yield forgone −$3.70, net −$67.42 for 2.2 hours of work (−$31.12 an hour) — verdict SKIP. Exit by redeeming through the issuer at its stated window once any allocation lands. Cost: nothing to run the numbers. Time: 5 minutes.
